text:
Before: 2 roasted tomato halves (~100g), mushrooms (~40g), avocado (~40g), butter (~10g), 2 slices of raisin toast (~100g total), and a coffee with milk (~250ml).

After: about half of the tomato remains (~30g eaten... roughly 60g eaten), the butter is mostly left (maybe 2g eaten), the avocado and mushrooms are fully eaten, about 40g of toast remains (~60g eaten), and the coffee appears untouched or only slightly drunk.

Energy of what was eaten:
- Tomato, 70g: ~20 kcal plus oil, ~40 kcal
- Mushrooms, 40g with oil: ~30 kcal
- Avocado, 40g: ~64 kcal
- Butter, 2g: ~15 kcal
- Toast, 60g: ~165 kcal
- Coffee: not counted

Total: ~315 kcal, ~212g.
